column1: # PEOPLE THE ROOTS TREE DRAWS BY DECISION, NOT BY RULE (David, 17 November 2026). tools/build-tree-page.py reads this; one row per person.
#   kind  standin  a record that stands for somebody rather than naming them: drawn, and flagged `placeholder: true` on the canvas (research hotspots)
#         slip     a published name with a digit, a bracket or a note in it (a possible typing slip): drawn as it is published; the correction is David's, never a hiding
# A person already drawn on the maps keeps their place and only gets the flag; a person the maps skip becomes an unplaced card in tree.json `undrawn` (every such person does now, listed here or not).
# A conflict (died before born, or over 110 years) is a card showing the death only (the birth that cannot both be true is dropped), and is still listed in tree.report.json.
# The sorting buckets (tools/buckets.py, 42 records, check_site "no sorting buckets published") are NOT here and are never drawn (David, 17 November 2026).
